shared_elements: flat rectangular prepared panel / stela-like field on stone
justification: The only correspondence is the generic notion of a rectangular, framed panel prepared on stone for carving, with A perhaps preserving faint illegible relief traces; B, by contrast, shows a fully legible programme (winged disc with central sun, flanking figures facing a standing deity, and multiple ruled lines of script) of which nothing comparable is visible in A. Since A depicts no identifiable creatures, symbols or figures, there is no basis for shared iconographic relationships or arrangement beyond the trivial fact of a smoothed panel.
